messages:
Evelyn (partnerships): Quick check — LangChain reached out about a joint tech preview next Wed. They want to show our routing SDK + a gateway partner integration. Can we run through what we need to land?
Samir K: +1. High level: SDK ready, sample app, CI smoke tests, marketplace listing draft, and partner legal signoff. What are the hard blockers?
Maya P: I can own SDK docs + quickstart. Will need a minimal notebook, a function-calling example, and a short compatibility matrix for model variants. @Tom R (pm) do we have an announce window from PM/marketing?
Tom R (pm): Tentative announce window is Fri 2026-04-14 but legal wants a 48h embargo buffer after partner signoff. So integration needs to be code-complete by Tue 2026-04-11 COB.
Nina (solutions): We'll prepare a Dedicated + Private deployment guide. Need to sanity-check latency on a 40B-ish model on partner infra. Can infra partner (Lambda/RunAI/NVIDIA) confirm perf numbers?
Samir K: Also require a nightly CI smoke test that runs a small generation and verifies tokens/latency. Proposal: GH Actions job that runs on pull to the integration branch and nightly. Use model: redwood/mistral-40b-quant for perf baseline.
Evelyn (partnerships): I'll ping LangChain to lock down the code snippets they want in the demo (chain + callback examples) and ask LlamaIndex folks for connector acceptance criteria. We should avoid leaking partner logos before they sign off.
Maya P: Draft quickstart snippet (will link sample later):
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('RW_KEY'))
resp = client.generate('Summarize the following...')
print(resp.text)
```
Will include gateway config block + example for streaming.
Tom R (pm): Marketing needs 1) short blurb (<=50 words), 2) 1-2 screenshots, 3) joint partner quote. Can we commit screenshots by Thu?
Nina (solutions): Solutions will produce a runbook and a small terraform snippet for Dedicated. Will also capture observed p50/p95 numbers and a short troubleshooting section.
Samir K: Who's owning the GH repo link and the CI? I can spin up the repo and add a placeholder GH action. Need access for partner CI keys — security will want a limited service account.
Evelyn (partnerships): Action items: Maya -> SDK docs + quickstart by Mon; Samir -> repo + CI scaffold by Mon; Nina -> deployment guide draft by Tue; Tom -> coordinate legal/marketing deadlines and partner PR window. I'll coordinate partner signoff cadence.
devrel-bot: reminder: please fill the partner-integration checklist https://redwood.internal/partner-checklist (required before any external demo) :memo:
Maya P: noted. I'll post the docs PR link when ready.
Tom R (pm): Thanks all — let's sync Wed 9am PT if anything slips. :eyes:
